highlights:
## 🃏 Answer Nod right in the chat

Questions and approvals now appear as cards in Nod web and desktop chat. Pick a choice or type your own answer on the card. When you can pick several, select them and then **Done**.

An approval shows the action and **Cancel**. For an email or message, the card lists the recipients, subject and text exactly as Nod will send them. After you answer, the card stays in the conversation with what happened: done, cancelled, expired or may have run. Telegram and WhatsApp still take a written reply. [How approvals work](https://nod.n8n.io/docs/trust/approvals/)

## 🪟 Better on Windows

- File and command tools find Nod's workspace folder, so Nod can read and edit the documents it creates.
- The app window, taskbar and installer show the Nod icon.

## Also in this release

- **Models:** Groq Qwen, Ollama, OpenRouter's free router and MiMo no longer reject Nod's requests. **Reload models** in Settings > Models refreshes a connection's models and effort options. [Connect models](https://nod.n8n.io/docs/connect/models/)
- **Gmail:** An email with a very long recipient list or many headers no longer stops inbox updates.
- **Schedules:** A run that starts over 10 minutes late is told when it was due and how many later runs were skipped.
- **Learned skills:** Nod can't overwrite a skill you edited.
- **Chat:** Voice messages show their time and menu below the player. Icon buttons show labels on hover.
- **Onboarding:** If sharing your About you answers fails, the main button continues and **Retry sharing** stays available.
